description: This is a stylized 3D model of a retro television set, featuring a vibrant blue, chunky body with rounded edges. It has a dark grey frame around the screen, which displays a classic color bar test pattern with a bright white element. Two dark grey V-shaped antennae protrude from the top. The right side of the television includes horizontal vent details, a square recess, and a cluster of two small circular knobs and one larger gear-like knob, all in dark grey. The unit stands on four small, dark grey feet, evoking a playful and cartoonish aesthetic.
